text:
nina.pm: quick check on the role-matrix draft i uploaded. main asks: make invite role-first, pick SSO toggle wording, and improve audit filter discoverability
omar.design: role-first is cleaner. visual note: invite CTA currently draws more attention than role chips
min-ux: suggestion: tone down CTA color + add small caret so it's read as a modal opener, keep role pill as primary control
lee.eng: prefer single control for SRs. make role pill aria-expanded to open inline picker; avoid extra buttons for screen readers
audit-bot: reminder: if SSO toggles, emit audit event with tenant_id and request_id for retention
nina.pm: SSO label: "SSO required" vs "Require SSO for org"? Thoughts?
omar.design: label="SSO required" + helper text "All new users must sign in via your SSO provider." keeps label short
min-ux: ensure helper is linked via aria-describedby and announce state changes in live region
lee.eng: backend will emit event type sso_policy_change with before/after and actor id; we'll add GET /audit/summary?org_id to return counts per type
nina.pm: audit nav: users can't find invite events. propose horizontal filter chips with counts and keyboard roving tabindex
omar.design: chips look good. add visible focus ring and arrow-key nav
min-ux: when filter applied announce "Invites filter applied, 8 results" via aria-live. also add keyboard shortcut to focus filters
lee.eng: inline role edits should emit role_inline_update events. mobile fallback opens a sheet. we'll also add route shim to accept view=auditable for scrapers
nina.pm: thanks — i'll add acceptance criteria to PRJ-8350 with figma and keyboard spec. please add blockers there
audit-bot: staging deploy queued after code review
